name: Nazareth
summary: The official Survey of Israel national parcel FeatureServer was reached anonymously. Its metadata and three bounded Nazareth-labelled parcel polygons were verified and one canonical native composite identity per retained feature was preserved. No local Nazareth registry custodian was separately evidenced, and runtime admission remains held.
queryOutcomes: English, Hebrew, and Arabic first-party discovery queries were executed. English/Hebrew searches identified GovMap, Survey of Israel, Topocad documentation, and the official parcel FeatureServer; Arabic added no separate usable first-party route.
requestOutcomes: Layer metadata and bounded object-ID/geometry GETs succeeded over normal TLS. The exact immutable WUP point route returned an invalid-field error and then timed out; neither was interpreted as citywide absence. Temporary raw response evidence is under tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/2413/ and is not retained in the cohort packet.
scopeLimits: The source is national, not a Nazareth municipal registry.
The locality query returned only three IDs with exceededTransferLimit=true; it is a bounded sample, not a complete city extract.
The sample polygons are Nazareth-labelled records near the city but are not claimed to contain the immutable WUP point.
The exact-point error/timeout is a route limitation, not evidence of no parcel at the point.
Native CRS is EPSG:2039; retained GeoJSON is reprojected to EPSG:4326 and contains only geometry plus canonical id.
No owner, titleholder, address, contact, personal, tax, account, deed, mutation, or other unsafe fields were retained.

nativeFieldMapping.geometry: ArcGIS polygon geometry; outSR=4326 in retained sample

admissionDecision: Do not admit or enable a runtime adapter. Serial reviewer must independently qualify a real adapter with stable identity, geometry validity, CRS handling, geographic filtering, and service behavior.
uncertainty: The official national cadastral source is real and usable for bounded safe samples, but full Nazareth coverage, current service freshness, exact-point behavior, and local-registry custody remain unresolved.
